comments.body: Add a doc string to `Outcome` (STYLE.md: every definition, structure and inductive has one).
Add a doc string to `errorClass`, e.g. the class name used in `error` files for an oracle `Error`.

last.summary:
The change does what the task asks, with one STYLE.md violation to fix.

Verified:
- `projects/bzip2/tools/verify.sh` passes. Its lines: `verify: packages: ok`, `verify: sources: ok`, `verify: build: ok`, `verify: style: ok`, `verify: axioms: ok`, `verify: lint: ok`, `verify: test: ok`, `bzip2-tests: 0 passed, 53 skipped, 0 failed`, `verify: ok`. The task names no check-task.sh check.
- Files: `git diff origin/master...HEAD` touches only `tests/Bzip2/Tests.lean` and `tests/vectors/*`. The two-dot diff shows `spec/.../Bwt.lean` only because master has moved on.
- `sh tests/vectors/regenerate.sh` reproduces the committed vectors with no `git status` change. The vectors total 1.9 MB.
- I ran the freshly built vendored `bzip2 -dc` on every `decompress/*/input`. Output matches `expected` byte for byte on all 16 success cases. Exit status is 2 with the right message on all 7 error cases: not a bzip2 file for `bad-magic` and `level0`, data integrity for `flip-block-crc`, and ends unexpectedly for `trunc-header`, `trunc-block`, `trunc-footer` and `zero-length`. `trailing-garbage` exits 0 with the "trailing garbage after EOF ignored" warning.
- I read the README's citations: `bzlib.c:194` (nblockMAX), `bzlib.c:295-302` and `390-392` (block full), `bzlib.c:824-831` and `841-848` (block and combined CRC return `BZ_DATA_ERROR`), `bzlib.c:1204-1209` (`BZ_UNEXPECTED_EOF`), `decompress.c:197-208` (magic and level check, so `BZh0` is `BZ_DATA_ERROR_MAGIC`) and `bzip2.c:533-543` (trailing garbage ignored when `streamNo != 1`). All are accurate.
- I counted block magics in the compressed inputs: `block-at-limit` has 1 block and `block-over-limit` has 2, as the README says.
- The `flip-block-crc` vector flips byte 10, the first byte of the stored block CRC after `BZh9` and the 6-byte block magic, and it yields `data`.
- Skip and fail logic: `Error.unimplemented` gives SKIP, any other mismatch gives FAIL, and the exit status is 1 iff `failed > 0`.

Requested change:
- STYLE.md says "Every definition, structure and inductive has a doc string". `tests/Bzip2/Tests.lean` has seven declarations without one: `Outcome`, `Counts`, `errorClass`, `isUnimplemented`, `caseDirs`, `report` and `main`. The lint stage does not cover the test driver, so verify does not catch it. Add a one-line doc string to each, saying what it is.

Not required, so not a request: Lean helpers are declared at the root namespace (allowed for `tests/`), and `vendoredBzip2` re-runs the build script, a hash check when cached, once per compress check.
